sloka: ततः प्रयातः सहसा राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः।रावणः सत्त्वगाम्भीर्याद्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.९६.२९ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prayātaḥ sahasā rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ।rāvaṇaḥ sattvagāmbhīryāddārayanniva medinīm ।। 6.96.29 ।।

translations.english: Duly permitted by Ravana, Mahaparsva and Mahodara who are difficult to overpower and also Virupaksha ascended their chariots.
